mod child;
#[derive(thiserror::Error)]
struct Wrapper { #[source] source: std::io::Error }
impl std::error::Error for Wrapper {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&dyn std::error::Error> {
        match self { _ => child::SOURCE }
    }
}
struct CrossFile { source: Wrapper }
struct Unrelated { source: std::io::Error }
#[derive(Error)]
enum Family {
    Text(String),
    Borrowed(&'static String),
    Io(Wrapper),
    Named { err: Wrapper, message: String },
    Detail { detail: String },
    Plain { path: &'static String },
    StringSource { source: String, message: String },
    Multi(Wrapper, String),
    Unit,
    Qualified(<Wrapper as Contract>::Source),
    Parenthesized((Wrapper)),
    Absolute(::std::io::Error),
}
#[cfg(any())]
mod dormant {
    #[derive(Error)] struct Inactive { source: ::std::io::Error }
    mod inner {
        #[derive(thiserror::Error)]
        struct Nested { source: super::Inactive }
    }
}
struct CordialError { kind: CordialErrorKind }
impl core::error::Error for CordialError {}
#[cfg(test)] mod excluded {
    #[derive(Error)] enum Hidden { Text(String) }
}
macro_rules! opaque { () => { #[derive(Error)] enum Hidden { Text(String) } } }
fn nested_types() {
    #[derive(Error)] struct Local { source: std::io::Error }
}
// Unicode tests byte offsets without changing the line contract: λ
#[derive(Debug, Error, Clone)]
struct Unicode { source: Wrapper }
impl std::error::Error for Unicode {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&dyn std::error::Error> {
        let ignored = 1;
        match self { _ => None }
    }
}
struct CallOnly { source: Wrapper }
impl std::error::Error for CallOnly {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&dyn std::error::Error> {
        match self { _ => Some(&self.source) }
    }
}
fn read() -> Result<(), Wrapper> { std::fs::read("x")?; Ok(()) }
